snippet.title: LEGO® Batman™: Legacy of the Dark Knight Developer Diary - Future Games Show Spring Showcase 2026
snippet.description:
TT Games threw a Batarang-shaped developer diary into the Future Games Show Spring Showcase, revealing more about the caped crusader's exploits in LEGO Batman: Legacy of the Dark Knight. It's coming to PC, PlayStation and Xbox on the 29th of May, later this year.

Wishlist now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2215200/LEGO_Batman_Legacy_of_the_Dark_Knight/

https://www.youtube.com/@FutureGamesShow

#FutureGamesShow #FGS

Future Publishing uses the Epidemic Sound Library, Getty Image Library, Shutterstock Image Library, Motion Array and Adobe Creative Cloud
